hero.mark.en: AI PRODUCT BUILDER · PRODUCT × SYSTEMS × DEVELOPER GROWTH
hero.mark.zh: AI 产品构建者 · 产品 × 系统 × 开发者增长

hero.subtitle.en: I turn ambiguous ideas into working products, repeatable systems, and communities that build together.
hero.subtitle.zh: 我把模糊的想法做成可运行的产品、可复用的系统和共同创造的社区。

profile.products.desc.en: From an ambiguous opportunity to a testable AI-native experience.
profile.products.desc.zh: 从模糊机会到可测试的 AI 原生体验。

profile.systems.desc.en: Connect sourcing, production, distribution, and feedback so teams can repeat what works.
profile.systems.desc.zh: 打通采集、生产、分发与反馈，让团队能重复做对的事。

profile.builders.desc.en: Design clear paths from first task to meaningful contribution.
profile.builders.desc.zh: 设计从第一次上手到真实贡献的清晰路径。

profile.translation.desc.en: Turn complex technical capability into a story people can act on—and improve it with data.
profile.translation.desc.zh: 把复杂技术转译成可行动的叙事，再用数据持续迭代。

exp.xiaohongshu.impact.en: Built technical-brand infrastructure, developer contribution pathways, and AI prototypes at Xiaohongshu.
exp.xiaohongshu.impact.zh: 在小红书搭建技术品牌基础设施、开发者贡献路径，并参与 AI 原生产品原型探索。

exp.xiaohongshu.d1.en: Synthesized 500+ candidate decision records, six stakeholder interviews, and five benchmark studies to shape a Builder-oriented talent narrative and technical asset map.
exp.xiaohongshu.d1.zh: 基于 500+ 候选人决策记录、6 场访谈和 5 家标杆研究，协助建立面向「Builder」的人才叙事与技术资产地图。

exp.xiaohongshu.d2.en: Built a reusable technical-brand workflow from story sourcing and AI-assisted editing to multi-channel distribution and performance review.
exp.xiaohongshu.d2.zh: 从 0 到 1 搭建可复用的技术品牌工作流：技术故事采集、AI 辅助编辑、多渠道分发与数据复盘。

exp.xiaohongshu.d3.en: Designed and launched an open-source contributor pathway: 400 registrations against a target of 40, while supporting a technical account from 0 to 1,000+ followers in three weeks.
exp.xiaohongshu.d3.zh: 设计并上线开源贡献者机制；首期获得 400 人报名，达到 40 人目标的 10 倍，并支持技术账号在 3 周内从 0 增长至 1,000+ 关注者。

exp.xiaohongshu.d4.en: Contributed to early definition and prototype iterations for an AI companion product; received Best Aesthetic Award at the internal Buildathon.
exp.xiaohongshu.d4.zh: 参与 AI 陪伴产品的早期定义与原型迭代；在内部 Buildathon 中获 Best Aesthetic Award。

exp.bestcem.impact.en: AI product design, quality evaluation, and B2B SaaS delivery at a leading CEM platform
exp.bestcem.impact.zh: 在头部 CEM 平台做 AI 产品设计、质量评测，以及 B2B SaaS 项目交付

exp.bestcem.d1.en: Owned 0-to-1 product design for an AI-powered customer journey generator - competitive analysis, PRD with 16 exception scenarios and 30 acceptance test cases, 3 prompt templates across 6 industries, Axure prototype
exp.bestcem.d1.zh: 主导 AI 客户旅程生成器的 0-1：竞品拆解、PRD（含 16 个异常场景 + 30 条验收用例）、覆盖 6 个行业的 3 套 prompt 模板、Axure 原型

exp.bestcem.d2.en: Led AI text analysis quality audit on 34K labeled records - designed stratified sampling, verified 1,117 entries (83.5% accuracy), identified 5 error patterns, delivered taxonomy optimization; built a 5-module AI evaluation framework with 20+ metrics
exp.bestcem.d2.zh: 主导 AI 文本分析质量审核：3.4 万条标注数据做分层抽样，复核 1,117 条（准确率 83.5%），定位 5 类错误模式并优化分类体系；同步搭建了 5 模块、20+ 指标的 AI 评测框架

exp.bestcem.d3.en: Independently delivered 2 enterprise VOC projects - 10+ platforms, 70K+ data entries, 18 RPA workflows, Python ETL scripts, topic taxonomy (17x97), 4 dashboards, and a reusable delivery SOP
exp.bestcem.d3.zh: 独立交付 2 个企业 VOC 项目：10+ 平台、7 万+ 数据、18 个 RPA 流程、Python 清洗脚本、17×97 主题分类、4 个看板，外加一份可复用的交付 SOP

exp.bestcem.d4.en: Shipped SMS review workflow PRD (2 platforms, 3 scenarios, machine + human review) and multiple SaaS feature PRDs
exp.bestcem.d4.zh: 交付了短信复核流程 PRD（2 个平台、3 个场景，机审 + 人审）以及多个 SaaS 功能 PRD

edu.paris.d1.en: Completed course projects in French and English, collaborating across cultures

edu.paris.d2.en: Across 14 countries, saw firsthand how privacy design, payment habits and social media differ by region, and came away with a real feel for localization
edu.paris.d2.zh: 在 14 个国家亲身感受到隐私设计、支付习惯、社交媒体的地区差异，对本地化有了实感

edu.sjtu.d1.en: Applied Praat, SPSS, and NVivo across language-tech and data-analysis tasks to generate user/content insights
edu.sjtu.d1.zh: 用 Praat、SPSS、NVivo 做语言分析和数据处理，产出有效洞察

edu.sjtu.d2.en: Explored core NLP and LLM use cases, with emphasis on multilingual product scenarios and system-level understanding
edu.sjtu.d2.zh: 接触 NLP 和 LLM 的核心场景，开始理解多语言产品设计

edu.sjtu.d3.en: Translated language-behavior and feedback signals into inputs for content and communication strategy
edu.sjtu.d3.zh: 把语言行为和用户反馈变成内容策略的输入
